verdict.rationale: Temporal documents Worker fleets pulling from Task Queues, with tuning guidance (temporal-docs-29, temporal-docs-49) and serverless Workers that autoscale to available work (temporal-docs-22, temporal-docs-28). It also claims execution resumes after crashes and survives Worker restarts (temporal-docs-1, temporal-docs-25), and users confirm it distributes work across machines with retry on failure (temporal-comm-7, temporal-comm-8). Missing for 10: an explicit doc statement that tasks are load-balanced across Workers polling a shared Task Queue, evidence that throughput scales roughly linearly as Workers are added (benchmarks or hands-on reports), and documented reassignment of in-flight tasks when a Worker dies (e.g., timeouts).
